Nobunaga was a soldier of fortune who defeated Imagawa Yoshimoto in the Battle of Okehazama, using her Noble Phantasm of rotating volley tactics. Her campaign ended in Kyoto due to Akechi Mitsuhide's insurrection and her successor was Toyotomi Hideyoshi.

Appearance:
Her clothing that looks like a military uniform is something she prepared herself out of hobby upon being summoned as a Servant.

Personality:
Oda Nobunaga is a self-confident, flexible thinker who has worked to unify the country, but her end came from the insurrection of a vassal. She does not have a wish for the Holy Grail, but is likely to use it to make a mess.

Noble Phantasm:
Nobunaga's main Noble Phantasm is Three Line Formation, which deploys and fires three thousand matchlocks at once. It increases its attack power against Heroic Spirits with the Riding skill. Her second Noble Phantasm is Demon King of the Sixth Heaven, which is a Reality Marble that transforms her into an existence wielding absolute power against those possessing Mystery and Divinity. She used this to defeat Sakamoto Ryouma's Like a Soaring Dragon.

Combat:
Okita Souji is a Servant with Matchlocks and a Katana. She is able to levitate and surf on top of her rifles and fly at high speed. Oda Nobunaga has an edge over Okita at long range, but she is a very advantageous match up for her. In the Fate/Grand Order game, the advantage was turned against Okita. In the Fate/Grand Order game, the advantage was turned against Okita.

Oda Nobunaga was able to shoot down Maxwell's Demon with a single bullet, but due to his Devil's Proof skill, she was unable to kill him. Caster's Neo Fuhrer is so strong, even the combined efforts of Okita Souji, Oda Nobunaga empowered by all Command Spells, and spearless Li Shuwen are unable to take it down.
